# coolify_destination (Data Source)

Looks up a Coolify destination by UUID. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_destination" "app_net" {
  uuid = coolify_destination.app_net.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) Destination UUID.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `network` (String) Docker network name.
- `server_uuid` (String) Owning server UUID.
- `type` (String) `standalone` or `swarm`.
